--========================================================
-- ANIMATIONS
--========================================================

local Animations = {
	{"Wave", "128777973"},
	{"Point", "128853357"},
	{"Laugh", "129423131"},
	{"Cheer", "129423030"},

	{"Dance 1", "182435998"},
	{"Dance 2", "182436842"},
	{"Dance 3", "182436935"},

	{"Dance 1 Variant", "182491037"},
	{"Dance 2 Variant", "182491248"},
	{"Dance 3 Variant", "182491368"},

	{"Tool Hold", "182393478"},
	{"Tool Slash", "129967390"},
	{"Tool Lunge", "129967478"},

	{"Sit", "178130996"},

	{"Sword Swing", "32659699"},
	{"Sword Thrust", "32659703"},
	{"Two Hand Sword Swing", "32659706"}
}

--========================================================
-- ANIMATION SYSTEM
--========================================================

local CurrentTrack

local function StopAnimation()
	if CurrentTrack then
		pcall(function()
			CurrentTrack:Stop(0.2)
			CurrentTrack:Destroy()
		end)
		CurrentTrack = nil
	end
end

local function PlayAnimation(ID)

	local Character = Player.Character
	if not Character then
		return
	end

	local Humanoid = Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not Humanoid then
		return
	end

	local Animator = Humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")

	if not Animator then
		Animator = Instance.new("Animator")
		Animator.Parent = Humanoid
	end

	StopAnimation()

	local Animation = Instance.new("Animation")
	Animation.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://" .. ID

	local Success, Track = pcall(function()
		return Animator:LoadAnimation(Animation)
	end)

	Animation:Destroy()

	if not Success or not Track then
		warn("Could not load animation: " .. ID)
		return
	end

	CurrentTrack = Track
	Track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
	Track.Looped = true

	pcall(function()
		Track:Play(0.2)
	end)
end

--========================================================
-- CREATE BUTTONS
--========================================================

local AnimationButtons = {}

for Index, Data in ipairs(Animations) do

	local Name = Data[1]
	local ID = Data[2]

	local Button = Instance.new("TextButton")
	Button.Name = Name
	Button.Size = UDim2.new(1, -5, 0, 50)
	Button.BackgroundColor3 = DARK2
	Button.BorderSizePixel = 0
	Button.Text = ""
	Button.AutoButtonColor = false
	Button.LayoutOrder = Index
	Button.Parent = List

	local Corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	Corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 9)
	Corner.Parent = Button

	local NameText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	NameText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	NameText.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 5)
	NameText.Size = UDim2.new(1, -120, 0, 22)
	NameText.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	NameText.Text = Name
	NameText.TextColor3 = WHITE
	NameText.TextSize = 14
	NameText.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	NameText.Parent = Button

	local IDText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	IDText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	IDText.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 27)
	IDText.Size = UDim2.new(1, -120, 0, 16)
	IDText.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	IDText.Text = "ID: " .. ID
	IDText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(135, 140, 150)
	IDText.TextSize = 10
	IDText.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	IDText.Parent = Button

	local PlayText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	PlayText.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
	PlayText.Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0.5, 0)
	PlayText.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(55, 27)
	PlayText.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 70, 135)
	PlayText.BorderSizePixel = 0
	PlayText.Text = "PLAY"
	PlayText.TextColor3 = WHITE
	PlayText.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	PlayText.TextSize = 10
	PlayText.Parent = Button

	local PlayCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	PlayCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7)
	PlayCorner.Parent = PlayText

	Button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		PlayAnimation(ID)
	end)

	table.insert(AnimationButtons, {
		Button = Button,
		Name = string.lower(Name)
	})
end

--========================================================
-- SEARCH
--========================================================

Search:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()

	local Query = string.lower(Search.Text)

	for _, Data in ipairs(AnimationButtons) do

		if Query == "" then
			Data.Button.Visible = true
		else
			Data.Button.Visible =
				string.find(Data.Name, Query, 1, true) ~= nil
		end

	end
end)

--========================================================
-- STOP
--========================================================

Stop.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	StopAnimation()
end)

--========================================================
-- CREDITS PAGE
--========================================================

CreditsPage.BorderSizePixel = 0

local CreditsTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")

CreditsTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 40)

CreditsTitle.Text = "Credits"

CreditsTitle.TextSize = 27
CreditsTitle.Parent = CreditsPage

local CreditsText = Instance.new("TextLabel")

CreditsText.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
CreditsText.Text =
	"Another Script from @AmongTheYoutuber from YouTube\n\nThanks for Using this script!"
CreditsText.TextColor3 = WHITE

CreditsText.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
CreditsText.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center

local Back = Instance.new("TextButton")
Back.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
Back.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -20)
Back.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(180, 40)
Back.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 70, 135)
Back.BorderSizePixel = 0
Back.Text = "←  ANIMATIONS"
Back.TextColor3 = WHITE
Back.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
Back.TextSize = 12
Back.Parent = CreditsPage

local BackCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
BackCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 9)
BackCorner.Parent = Back

CreditsButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	List.Visible = false
	Search.Visible = false
	Stop.Visible = false
	Destroy.Visible = false
	CreditsPage.Visible = true
end)

Back.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	List.Visible = true
	Search.Visible = true
	Stop.Visible = true
	Destroy.Visible = true
	CreditsPage.Visible = false
end)

--========================================================
-- MINI CIRCLE
--========================================================

local Mini = Instance.new("TextButton")
Mini.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
Mini.Position = UDim2.new(1, -25, 1, -25)
Mini.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(60, 60)
Mini.BackgroundColor3 = BLACK
Mini.BorderSizePixel = 0
Mini.Text = "AH"
Mini.TextColor3 = WHITE
Mini.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
Mini.TextSize = 16
Mini.Visible = false
Mini.Parent = Gui

local MiniCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
MiniCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
MiniCorner.Parent = Mini

local MiniStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
MiniStroke.Color = BLUE
MiniStroke.Thickness = 3
MiniStroke.Parent = Mini

--========================================================
-- OPEN / CLOSE
--========================================================

local OpenSize = UDim2.fromOffset(520, 520)

local function OpenGUI()

	Mini.Visible = false
	Main.Visible = true

	Main.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(1, 1)

	TweenService:Create(
		Main,
		TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
		{Size = OpenSize}
	):Play()
end

local function CloseGUI()

	Main.Visible = false
	Mini.Visible = true

	Mini.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(1, 1)

	TweenService:Create(
		Mini,
		TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
		{Size = UDim2.fromOffset(60, 60)}
	):Play()
end

Close.MouseButton1Click:Connect(CloseGUI)

Mini.MouseButton1Click:Connect(OpenGUI)

--========================================================
-- DESTROY - DIRECT AND RELIABLE
--========================================================

Destroy.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	StopAnimation()

	-- Destroy the actual ScreenGui.
	-- This also removes the mini circle.
	if Gui then
		Gui:Destroy()
	end

end)

--========================================================
-- DRAGGING
--========================================================

local Dragging = false
local DragStart
local StartPosition

Header.InputBegan:Connect(function(Input)

	if Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		Dragging = true
		DragStart = Input.Position
		StartPosition = Main.Position
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(Input)

	if not Dragging then
		return
	end

	if Input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
		and Input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		return
	end

	local Delta = Input.Position - DragStart

	Main.Position = UDim2.new(
		StartPosition.X.Scale,
		StartPosition.X.Offset + Delta.X,
		StartPosition.Y.Scale,
		StartPosition.Y.Offset + Delta.Y
	)
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(Input)

	if Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		Dragging = false
	end
end)

--========================================================
-- INITIAL OPEN
--========================================================

Main.Visible = true

print("Animations Hub V3 loaded successfully!")
